backend_tooltips_raw.counterfactual_strength: (float) - Fraction of the diffusion noise schedule used for inversion, from 0 to 1. Lower values retain more of the source but may change the phenotype less. Zero leaves the crop unchanged. Used only by the diffusion counterfactual generator. Default 0.95.
backend_tooltips_raw.counterfactual_structure_weight: (float) - Nonnegative weight of the diffusion training penalty for changes in spatial gradients at several scales. Uniform channel offsets are not penalized. This encourages layout retention but does not guarantee biological identity or phenotype success. Zero keeps denoising-only training. Used only by the diffusion counterfactual generator. Default 0.
